title: Inside Amgen's Culture of Quality, Safety, and Compliance
summary: For the Operations team at Amgen Rhode Island, quality and compliance aren't just regulatory checkboxes, they are the foundation of delivering innovative medicines to patients worldwide.
body_markdown:
For the Operations team at Amgen Rhode Island, quality and compliance aren't just regulatory checkboxes, they are the foundation of delivering innovative medicines to patients worldwide.


As manufacturing specialist Giovanni Illiano puts it: "Safety is such an important aspect of my life that my 3-year-old daughter, Lily, walks around the house saying 'safety first,' it makes me proud as a dad."


**Key Pillars of Our Manufacturing Standards:**


- **Unwavering Commitment:** Celebrating Quality Month across global sites to reinforce year-round safety protocols
- **Patient-First Mission:** Ensuring every step of discovery, development, and manufacturing meets the highest industry standards
- **Global Impact:** Empowering local manufacturing teams to drive operational excellence
